Errors are measured on original price scale. MdAPE and MAPE are percentages; lower is better. Pooled MdAPE uses individual homes from all evaluated months, not the mean of monthly medians. Reference rows below are recomputed from unrounded saved predictions.

Evidence boundary. June–November 2025 is development data used to choose hyperparameters; November had already been examined in an HGB probe. December 2025–May 2026 and the fixed-February horizon were observed in earlier model development. These are reused/adaptive backtests, not a new untouched holdout or an unbiased estimate after model selection. June–September 2026 hidden targets are unavailable.

Every HGB/reference comparison below verified identical ml_num, month, training_cutoff, sold_price. There were 12 successful identity comparisons. RF and Bagging are both shown; the original selected family is identified by old_frozen_reference=True. Each month uses sales strictly before its start; horizon models fit once before 2026-02-01 without adding February–May labels.

Training, recent-training and future diagnostics

Full-history and recent-12-month training errors are in-sample diagnostics. They represent different time/cohort distributions from future-month evaluation. Six overlapping training sets cannot be pooled or averaged and interpreted as a standard i.i.d. generalization gap. Compare the same cohort across model configurations and inspect monthly trends. The evaluated checkpoint and number of iterations physically trained are recorded separately.

Development selection and checkpoint search

Capacity is screened at 200 iterations before the retained capacity paths are compared at predeclared checkpoints. This is a budget-limited sequential search; capacity and iteration interactions can cause the best joint configuration to be missed. The globally selected iteration count for each track is reused in subsequent folds and final fitting; an evaluation month does not receive its own retrospectively selected iteration count. List-aware target ablation changes only log-price versus log-ratio target after choosing encoding and capacity.

Community rankings are descriptive, especially for small groups. Complete community groups and both original reference models are retained in grouped_metrics.csv. Home-resampling confidence intervals, if calculated elsewhere, do not fully describe shared market shocks and do not correct adaptive selection.

Runtime and accounting

Multiple checkpoint artifacts can refer to one physical fit. The runtime CSV deduplicates physical_fit_id; duplicated checkpoint times are not summed. It contains 188 unique recorded HGB fit IDs. These are evaluation fits; final full-data fitting is recorded in the final summary separately. Candidate metrics and checkpoint evaluations are separate accounting units.
